items.html: And with this you will understand a true reason why the four couplings and the four drawings of the Shema are not equal, and everything depends on what was mentioned: for behold, according to the preparation that ZA has at the time he raises Mayin Nukvin in the word "Echad," so is the power in him to draw an upper or lower drawing. And also in this matter depends the entry of the Mochin of Gadlut into him afterwards — whether they all enter, or some of them. And also in this depends the difference in the excellence of the couplings, that this coupling is greater than that one. And all this is in the aforementioned beginning, for if the beginning is excellent at the time of the raising of Mayin Nukvin, so does he have the power to draw upper drawings from above; and it is found that everything depends on this matter.
